geometry.coordinate_space: raw LTB coordinates; decoder does not center, scale, or rotate

normals.evidence: decoded from the LTB vertex stream

tangents.evidence: no tangent field is decoded from LTB

bone_weights.evidence: up to three vertex weight values decoded

bone_indices.evidence: decoded from packed per-vertex-range node-index records and validated against the LTB node-count header; 255 is the empty influence sentinel

skeleton_nodes.evidence: decoded node names, preorder child counts, parent links, and 4x4 bind matrices

bind_pose.evidence: weighted bind-pose round-trip was evaluated against the decoded node matrices

animation_clips.evidence: LTB animation blocks are not decoded

material_bindings.evidence: no direct material reference was decoded

coordinate_transform.evidence: raw coordinates are preserved; OBJ exporter transform is reported separately

limitations: This report does not claim CF skeleton or animation support.
Weight values, packed per-vertex bone indices, node hierarchy, and bind matrices are decoded; animation blocks and material bindings remain unresolved.
The OBJ exporter still applies its legacy center-and-4.5-scale transform; use raw coordinates for B3.
A mesh texture hint is not proof that the corresponding DTX/Shader material was resolved.
